name: WPC Checkout Restrictions for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
The WPC Checkout Restrictions plugin for WooCommerce is a powerful tool that empowers store owners to customize and control the checkout process with precision. This plugin allows you to set specific restrictions based on a variety of conditions, ensuring that only eligible customers can complete their purchases.

Key Features

  • User Role Restrictions: Limit checkout to specific user roles, giving you the ability to restrict purchases to authorized customers only.
  • Cart Content Restrictions: Define rules such as minimum or maximum cart totals required for checkout, or block checkout if certain products are present in the cart.
  • Advanced Time Restrictions: Implement sophisticated time-based rules to control checkout availability. Set multiple conditions such as specific time windows, recurring schedules, or exceptions for holidays, ensuring your store’s checkout process aligns perfectly with your operational needs.
  • Custom Messages: Display personalized messages to inform customers about the restrictions and provide clear guidance on how to meet the checkout requirements.

Why Use It?

This plugin is an excellent solution for managing promotions, controlling checkout availability, or enforcing specific purchase conditions. Whether you’re running a time-sensitive offer, restricting access to exclusive products during certain hours, or ensuring compliance with your store’s operational schedule, WPC Checkout Restrictions offers the flexibility you need.

Compatibility & Reception

Fully compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce, the plugin has earned positive feedback from users for its effectiveness and ease of use. It’s a reliable choice for store owners looking to enhance control over their checkout experience.

With WPC Checkout Restrictions, you can streamline your store’s operations and create a tailored shopping experience that meets your business goals.

sections.installation:
1. Please make sure that you installed WooCommerce
  2. Go to plugins in your dashboard and select “Add New”
  3. Search for “WPC Checkout Restrictions”, Install & Activate it
  4. Go to WP-admin > Checkout Restrictions to add rules
